One row of numbers per model

Source: R/model.R
vp_summary.Rd

One row of numbers that describe a model. Give one model, or several (they are stacked, one row each).

Usage

vp_summary(...)

Arguments

...

One or more models (from vp_read). Named arguments give the column model its values.

Value

A tibble with one row per model and the columns model, features (variable), core, dead, atomic_sets, requires, excludes, atleastone (NA without or_graph = TRUE), skeleton (arrows), primitive_conflicts, implicit_requires (share of arrows that follow from others), implicit_excludes (share of conflicts that are inherited), density_requires, density_excludes, depth, width, cross_tree_share, hierarchy_share, gini_required_by, gini_excludes, mean_decision_power, isolated (features in no graph), coupling (share of features with at least one strong relationship), skeleton_per_feature (links of the skeleton per node: density by meaning), largest_atomic_set (the size of the largest group of mutually dependent features, Baldwin et al.'s "core"), largest_alternative_group, representativeness (the share of vp_representativeness(), NA when the run did not measure it).

Details

The counts, densities, concentrations, isolated and coupling read the graphs as they are given (on the minimal form, vp_minimal(), they describe the written structure); the other numbers are inferences and use the complete graphs.

See also

Other whole model: vp_check(), vp_degree_distribution(), vp_gini()

Examples

band <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3.uvl"))
axtls <- vp_generate(vp_example("axTLS.uvl"))
vp_summary(band = band, axTLS = axtls)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 28
#>   model form     features  core  dead atomic_sets requires excludes atleastone
#>   <chr> <chr>       <int> <int> <int>       <int>    <int>    <int>      <int>
#> 1 band  complete       11     8     0           2       36       18         NA
#> 2 axTLS complete       61    19    11           7       56       13         NA
#> # ℹ 19 more variables: skeleton <int>, primitive_conflicts <int>,
#> #   implicit_requires <dbl>, implicit_excludes <dbl>, density_requires <dbl>,
#> #   density_excludes <dbl>, depth <int>, width <int>, cross_tree_share <dbl>,
#> #   hierarchy_share <dbl>, gini_required_by <dbl>, gini_excludes <dbl>,
#> #   mean_decision_power <dbl>, isolated <int>, coupling <dbl>,
#> #   skeleton_per_feature <dbl>, largest_atomic_set <int>,
#> #   largest_alternative_group <dbl>, representativeness <dbl>
